description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger queries. Should-trigger covers DE + EN phrasings for adversarial review of an agent's CONFIG/behaviour (rules, skills, MCP, hooks, permissions). Should-not-trigger covers the near-miss neighbours (code threat-model, code security-audit, the static config-audit command, privacy review, dependency CVE scan) whose vocabulary overlaps.

queries.q: red-team my agent setup — could someone weaponise my CLAUDE.md or MCP servers?
do an adversarial security review of this agent config and its skills
is this third-party skill pack safe to install, attacker's view?
prüfe meine Agent-Konfiguration adversarial auf Angriffsketten
what could an attacker do with my rules files, hooks and tool permissions?
threat-model this new payments endpoint before I build it
find vulnerabilities in my application code
give me an A-F score for my agent config
queries.note: static scored audit → /security-audit-config command, not the adversarial skill

queries.q: are we GDPR compliant with this data flow?
scan my dependencies for known CVEs
queries.note: dependency CVE audit → security-audit dependency pass
